title: Characteristics of aquarium Dubrovnik and Boka visits
reference: Radoje Laušević, Mirjana Bartula (2024): Characteristics of aquarium Dubrovnik and Boka visits. International conference “Adriatic Biodiversity Protection – AdriBioPro2024”. 01-04 October 2024, Kotor, Montenegro. Book of Abstracts. 2024. Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro. 104.
venue: International conference “Adriatic Biodiversity Protection – AdriBioPro2024”. 01-04 October 2024, Kotor, Montenegro. Book of Abstracts.
publisher: Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro
description: This paper analyzes visitor characteristics at Aquarium Dubrovnik (Croatia) and Aquarium Boka (Montenegro) based on surveys conducted in October 2022. A total of 2,998 questionnaires were collected from visitors at both locations, focusing on socio-demographics, biodiversity knowledge, and engagement. The study found notable differences between the two aquaria. Aquarium Boka attracted mainly school groups and had higher visitor numbers, while Aquarium Dubrovnik had more individual visitors.
